sources: cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for every Carpios Ridge site, read 2026-10-27

values.note: Every site has electric (20/30/50 A on most, 50 A on sites 4 and 6). Only the 7 full-hookup sites (1-4, 6, 62, 63) have water and sewer, April 16 - November 14; their water is off November 15 - April 15 and they sell at a reduced rate.

hookups.source: CPW camping page ('Electrical services are available at every site in the Carpios Ridge Campground, with sites 1-4, 6, 62 and 63 offering full hook-ups from April 16 to November 14'; 'Water will be turned off to full hook-up sites beginning November 15 to April 15') + cpwshop campsiteDetails (55 Electric + 1 Electric-ADA at 20/30/50; 7 Full Hookup at 20/30/50 or 50), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 56 electric sites and 7 full-hookup sites, listed for vehicles 25-110 ft (most 33-50 ft), so all 63 take a 23-ft rig. 3 pull-throughs (12 at 110 ft, 42 at 80, 61 at 85).

sites.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails, Carpios Ridge (Maximum Vehicle Length 25-110; Driveway Entry: Pull-Through on 012, 042HA, 061), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: CPW camping page ('a camper services building with showers, laundry, and flush toilets is open from mid-March to mid-October'; 'Alternative restrooms are available at the Camper Services building in the Carpios Ridge Campground'; 'Water hydrants'; 'Dump station'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Open all year at sites 1-23, 62 and 63 (electric at every site, water at community hydrants). Showers and laundry close mid-October to mid-March; the family restrooms stay open.

season.source: CPW camping page ('Trinidad Lake is open year-round for camping at sites 1 to 23, 62 and 63. Electricity is available at all sites, and water is available at community water hydrants'; 'Showers and laundry facilities (closed in winter)'; 'During the winter season, the family restrooms are available'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people and one camper/RV plus one tent per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass.

booking.source: CPW camping page ('A reservation is required to camp at Trinidad Lake State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-10-27

note: Campground on Carpios Ridge above the north shore of Trinidad Lake, with the camper-services building. --Claude
